intended_use: Research screening estimation for Indian adults aged 20 years and above once authorised ICMR-INDIAB data are received, verified, and trained. Not a clinical diagnostic tool.
population: Indian adults aged 20+ (men and women, rural and urban, across Indian states and union territories). Do not extrapolate to 18-19-year-olds.
external_validation: External validation has not yet been completed.
clinical_disclaimer: This estimate is from a research screening model, not a clinical diagnosis. Consult a qualified healthcare provider for clinical testing and evaluation.
